documentation.overview: Scaffold implements the basic Material Design visual layout structure. This class provides APIs for showing app bars, navigation drawers, floating action buttons, persistent bottom sheets, and snack bars.
documentation.purpose: Acts as the primary top-level visual container for screens and pages in a Flutter Material application.
documentation.installation: Included in the Flutter SDK by default via `import 'package:flutter/material.dart';`
documentation.configuration: Configure properties including appBar, body, floatingActionButton, drawer, bottomNavigationBar, and backgroundColor.
documentation.security_considerations: Ensure modal bottom sheets or overlays attached to Scaffold do not leak sensitive state or remain dismissable during sensitive transactional flows.
documentation.error_handling: Calling ScaffoldMessenger.of(context) requires a BuildContext below the Scaffold or ScaffoldMessenger ancestor.

symbols.name: Scaffold
symbols.syntax:
const Scaffold({
  Key? key,
  PreferredSizeWidget? appBar,
  Widget? body,
  Widget? floatingActionButton,
  FloatingActionButtonLocation? floatingActionButtonLocation,
  Widget? drawer,
  Widget? bottomNavigationBar,
  Widget? bottomSheet,
  Color? backgroundColor,
  bool? resizeToAvoidBottomInset,
})
symbols.description: Creates a visual scaffold for Material Design widgets.

parameters.name: appBar

parameters.description: The primary content displayed in the scaffold below the appBar.

parameters.name: floatingActionButton
parameters.description: A button displayed floating above body, in the bottom right corner by default.
